author: Roszczyk
title: GPU grid_sample_kernel_opt_bilinear.cpp fails clang-tidy braces/uppercase-literal checks
signature: clang-tidy readability-braces-around-statements statement should be inside braces and readability-uppercase-literal-suffix floating point literal suffix not uppercase in new GPU kernel code|Code Issue

failed_jobs.name: Build-gpu / Build
failed_jobs.symptom: Cmake build with clang-tidy enabled step fails compiling grid_sample_kernel_opt_bilinear.cpp due to 2 clang-tidy errors treated as -Werror

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status_clang_tidy
failed_jobs.symptom: Overall status check fails because the Build-gpu / Build job it depends on failed

key_errors: /__w/openvino/openvino/openvino/src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/kernel_selector/kernels/grid_sample/grid_sample_kernel_opt_bilinear.cpp:29:46: error: statement should be inside braces [readability-braces-around-statements,-warnings-as-errors]

/__w/openvino/openvino/openvino/src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/kernel_selector/kernels/grid_sample/grid_sample_kernel_opt_bilinear.cpp:30:50: error: floating point literal has suffix 'f', which is not uppercase [readability-uppercase-literal-suffix,-warnings-as-errors]
root_cause: PR #39291 adds new code in grid_sample_kernel_opt_bilinear.cpp (src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/kernel_selector/kernels/grid_sample/grid_sample_kernel_opt_bilinear.cpp, line 29-30) that violates two clang-tidy checks enforced as errors on this CI configuration: (1) readability-braces-around-statements - the body of an `if` without braces, and (2) readability-uppercase-literal-suffix - a lowercase `f` suffix on a floating point literal (`1.f` instead of `1.F`). Since CMAKE_COMPILE_WARNING_AS_ERROR is ON for this job, these clang-tidy diagnostics abort the build.
reproduction_steps: Build the GPU plugin locally with clang-tidy enabled (CMAKE_CXX_CLANG_TIDY=clang-tidy-18 or similar) and compile src/plugins/intel_gpu/src/kernel_selector/kernels/grid_sample/grid_sample_kernel_opt_bilinear.cpp; clang-tidy will report readability-braces-around-statements at line 29 and readability-uppercase-literal-suffix at line 30.
recommended_actions: Wrap the body of the `if (input.X().v == 1 && input.Y().v == 1)` statement at line 29 in braces.
Change the floating point literal suffix from `1.f` to `1.F` at line 30 to satisfy readability-uppercase-literal-suffix.
Re-run the GPU clang-tidy build locally before pushing to catch similar lint issues earlier.
prevention_strategies: Run clang-tidy locally (or via pre-commit/clang-tidy diff tooling) on newly added GPU kernel_selector files before pushing, since this CI job treats clang-tidy diagnostics as errors. Prefer always-braced single-statement bodies and uppercase numeric literal suffixes (F, L, U) in new OpenVINO GPU kernel_selector code to avoid recurring the braces-around-statements and uppercase-literal-suffix clang-tidy violations seen repeatedly in this component.
historical_context: A closely related recurring pattern (signature_hash a4282c65071120e2, 'GPU prepare_primitive_fusing clang-tidy braces-around-statements errors') has occurred 6 times in the last day across other GPU PRs, all Code Issue / clang-tidy braces-around-statements violations in newly added GPU plugin code. This is a new, distinct signature (different file and an added uppercase-literal-suffix violation) but the same systemic pattern of new GPU code not being pre-validated against the clang-tidy warnings-as-errors build before submission.
